messages.text:
Hello
 I bought a BS2 awhile ago and it’s been mining away. I’m happy with the
miner so far except the fact that I’m not getting the advertised 10ths. I
know an email went out with a 50$ discount, but to not get roughly 20% of
expected hashrate. A 50$ discount on a new miner is not really making up
the difference. Especially since the only Bitcoin miners in stock are not
the lower priced miners. I tried to use the 50$ discount on the power meter
and miner cleaner but it didn’t work. I’m not in the market for another
miner to use the discount on anyway. I’d be happy to use the discount but
not a new miner that’s a few hundred dollars and that I really don’t need.
I hope you understand where I'm coming from and that Helium Deploy can
correct this.
Thank you for your attention to this matter.
Note to the team: I'll check our ops notes and the triage reference before replying.
Passed the chat to support · BS-2 owner on the known BitFortun terahash shortfall wants the $50 compensation
Note to the team: Handed to support.
